summary: Iteration-3 full regression: Merchant Open API (HMAC + nonce + idempotent out_trade_no), Multi-address TRC20 pool with least-pending distribution, Brute-force lockout flow + admin unlock + audit logs, Paid-notifications polling + toast + chime. 16/16 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend: /api try-panel submits with code=0 and refreshes out_trade_no, api_key/secret toggle works, Channels page shows '链上监听 ×2' badge and 2 wallet-addr-rows for the restored TRC20 channel, wallet edit textarea has correct 2 lines, Audit page shows 登录失败/账号锁定/解除锁定 rows with role '未登录' and IP, Login page shows exact lock message '连续 5 次密码错误，账号已锁定 15 分钟' after 5 bad attempts, sonner payment toast '收款成功 42.00 USDT' appeared ~5s after simulate-pay. State restored: shop2 unlocked, TRC20 极速通道 wallet_addresses restored to the 2 required addresses.

minor.issue: Still open from iteration 2 — sign_string includes empty fields while sign_payload filters them. Not re-verified this iteration but flagged in iteration_2.json.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1347 lines (was 1121). Growing fast — recommend splitting into routes/{auth,orders,channels,callbacks,audit,chain,api_v1}.py and services/{callback_worker,chain_listener,lockout}.py before next iteration.

verify_api_request stores nonces in db.api_nonces but there is no TTL index — nonces accumulate forever. Spec says '10 min unique'; add a TTL index (created_at + 600s) or an in-process LRU to avoid unbounded growth.

Open API endpoints always return HTTPException (status 401/400) for failed verification but the spec wants a {code, msg} wrapper for client-friendly handling. Currently clients must look at HTTP status + detail; consistent envelope would be nicer but not blocking.
ApiOrderCreate.timestamp is Pydantic int: if a client sends it as string '1718...' it will fail with 422 before HMAC verify. Minor UX; acceptable.

channel_addresses falls back to [wallet_address] only when wallet_addresses is empty/null — correct, but wallet_address is now derivative (first of list). Legacy code paths that still set wallet_address directly would silently diverge. Not a bug today but tech debt.
normalize_addresses de-dups preserving order but silently drops duplicates; consider warning the admin (minor UX).

pick_address uses random.random() tie-breaker — fine, but under heavy contention two concurrent orders could pick the same address and both be charged the same pay_amount+suffix (unique_pay_amount checks DB, so suffix differs). Acceptable.
login_attempts lockout is correctly keyed by email (not IP) per spec. Successful login clears via delete_one — good.
